The corporation [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] had a secret '''installation''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]], where they conducted [[re-engineering]] experiments during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|Findsman]] [[Vaskau Farg]] tracked a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Unidentified Sakiyan scientist|contractor]] to the facility during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head.
